source: example: a fictional persona's answers to templates/voice_questionnaire.md (no sample stored; add yours under raw/extrovert/voice/)

traits.name: Short paragraphs
traits.description: Two or three sentences per paragraph, one idea each.

traits.name: A worked example first
traits.description: Shows a concrete query, command or number before the general rule.

traits.name: Rhetorical questions
traits.description: Asks the reader's question out loud, then answers it.
traits.public_note: at most 3 question-and-answer pairs per post

traits.name: Dry humor
traits.description: One understated joke, usually about the bug, never about a person.

traits.name: Chat shorthand
traits.description: 'tbh', 'imo' and lowercase 'i' in notes and transcripts.

humor.public: at most one joke per post

self_descriptions.rule: describe the work, not the person

raw.description: Notes and interview transcripts, as typed. Never published as is.

public.description: Medium and LinkedIn: plain, specific and calm. Short paragraphs, a worked example first, no shorthand.
rules: Lead with a concrete example, then the rule.
At most one joke per post, about the bug, never a person.
No capitals for emphasis; use a short sentence instead.

phrases: at the end of the day

checklist: One worked example before the general rule.
'We' for employer work, 'I' for personal work.
Every number from my notes or a cited source.
